question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Assuagement
solution: The correct answer is** "Mollification."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Assuagement"** means the act of making something less severe or painful. (किसी चीज़ को कम गंभीर या दर्दनाक बनाने की क्रिया) • **Example**: *The **assuagement**__ of his pain came from taking the prescribed medication.* • **"Mollification"** is a synonym of** "assuagement."** • It means the act of pacifying or soothing. (शांत करने की क्रिया) __ • **Example**: *His unsuccessful **mollification**__ of the mob was a significant act.* • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1: Consignment** means a batch of goods that are sent or delivered to someone. (माल का एक बैच जो किसी को भेजा या वितरित किया जाता है) • **Option 2: Stratification** means the arrangement or formation of layers or strata. (परतों की व्यवस्था या गठन) • **Option 3: Ruthlessness** means the lack of mercy or compassion; being cold-hearted or cruel. (दया या करुणा की कमी; ठंडे दिल वाला या क्रूर होना) 34:Tb55, The correct answer is **"Equalities."**
